info.title: VirtualPC Admin API — Auth/Audit/Dashboard/Security
info.description: Role-based admin API. Bearer auth via sessionId from POST /api/auth/login.

AuthUserSummary.description: Compact user identity returned alongside a session token.

AuthTokenResponse.description: Successful authentication. The `token` is the sessionId to send as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Sessions expire after 8 hours.

TwoFactorRequiredResponse.description: Returned by POST /api/auth/login with HTTP 200 when the account has 2FA enabled. No session is issued; exchange the challengeId via POST /api/auth/2fa/verify. Challenge expires after 5 minutes and is single-use.

code.description: 6-digit TOTP code from the authenticator app.

TwoFactorSetupResponse.description: Fresh TOTP secret and provisioning URI. Render the URI as a QR code.

code.description: 6-digit TOTP code generated from the setup secret.

TwoFactorDisableRequest.description: Disabling 2FA requires both the current password and a valid TOTP code.

RolePermissions.description: Boolean capability matrix for a role.

UserListItem.description: User entry as returned by GET /api/auth/users (no password hash).

SessionStatsResponse.description: Aggregate session/user statistics. The stats fields are spread onto the success envelope.

AuditEventSeverity.description: Severity classification of an audit event.

role.description: Role of the acting user (ceo, cto, developer, artist, tech_artist)

AuditStatistics.description: Aggregated counts computed from the in-memory audit event buffer.

failed_logins_by_ip.description: IPs with 3+ failed logins, sorted by count descending (brute-force detection)

daysOld.description: Delete events older than this many days. Must be >= 7.

MyDashboardResponse.description: Response from GET /api/dashboard/my. On success it carries the success flag, the role-resolved dashboard, and the caller's role. For an unrecognized role the handler returns the ErrorResponse 'Unknown role' shape instead.

dashboard.description: Role-specific dashboard. The concrete shape matches the caller's role.

CEODashboard.description: Full system view for the CEO. NOTE: the per-employee field is literally named 'teamEmpployeeStatus' (double-p typo) in the source and emitted JSON.

CTODashboard.description: Infrastructure and operations view for the CTO.

DeveloperDashboard.description: Task and code view for a Developer. `currentTask` is optional.

ArtistDashboard.description: Creative work view for an Artist.

TechArtistDashboard.description: Performance and optimization view for a Tech Artist.

example: Optimize main battle shader (potential 15% FPS gain)

score.description: Weighted composite security score (0-100): 0.7*audit_score + 0.3*twofa_adoption, minus threat penalties.

computed_at.description: ISO timestamp the snapshot was computed.

failed_login_rate_24h.description: Failed logins per active user over the last 24h.

critical_events_24h.description: Count of critical-severity audit events in the last 24h.

suspicious_ips.description: Number of IPs with >=3 failed logins in the last 24h.

by_role.description: User count keyed by role (ceo, cto, developer, artist, tech_artist).

post.description: Authenticates a user and issues a Bearer session token (valid 8h). Rate limited to 10 attempts per 15 minutes per (IP, username) pair, on top of a per-username brute-force lockout (5 failures -> 15 min cooldown). If the account has 2FA enabled the password check still passes but no session is issued: the response is HTTP 200 with { success:false, requires2fa:true, challengeId } and the client must call POST /api/auth/2fa/verify with the challengeId and a TOTP code.

parameters.name: X-Device-Id
parameters.description: Client device identifier, recorded against the session / 2FA challenge. Defaults to 'unknown-device'.

parameters.name: X-Location
parameters.description: Client location hint, recorded against the session / 2FA challenge. Defaults to 'unknown-location'.

200.description: Either a successful login (session token issued) OR a 2FA challenge requiring a second step. The HTTP status is 200 in both cases; distinguish via the `success` and `requires2fa` fields.

401.description: Invalid credentials, inactive account, or brute-force lockout.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (10 login attempts per 15 minutes per IP+username).

post.description: Exchanges the single-use challengeId returned by POST /api/auth/login (when requires2fa is true) together with a 6-digit TOTP code for a real session token. The challenge is consumed whether or not the code matches and expires 5 minutes after issuance. Shares the login rate limiter (10 attempts / 15 min per IP+username).

401.description: Invalid/expired challenge, invalid 2FA state, or invalid TOTP code.

post.description: Generates a fresh TOTP secret and otpauth:// URI for the authenticated user to render as a QR code. Must be followed by POST /api/auth/2fa/enable to actually arm 2FA. Calling setup again before enable rotates the secret. Rate limited to 30 mutations/min per IP.

200.description: Setup initiated; returns the secret and otpauth URI.

400.description: Setup could not be initiated (e.g. user not found).

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired Bearer token.

post.description: Confirms TOTP setup by submitting a code generated from the secret returned by POST /api/auth/2fa/setup, then arms 2FA on the account. Fails if setup has not been run. Rate limited to 30 mutations/min per IP.

400.description: Setup not run, or invalid 2FA code.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired Bearer token.

post.description: Disarms 2FA for the authenticated user. Requires BOTH the current password and a valid TOTP code, so a stolen session alone cannot disable 2FA. Rate limited to 30 mutations/min per IP.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired Bearer token.

post.description: Invalidates the session associated with the supplied Bearer token. Idempotent.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired Bearer token.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile plus their role-based permission matrix.

200.description: Profile and permissions for the current user.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired Bearer token.

post.description: Changes the authenticated user's password after verifying the old password. Rate limited to 30 mutations/min per IP.

400.description: Current password incorrect or user not found.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired Bearer token.

get.description: Returns all user accounts (without password hashes). Restricted to the CEO role via requireRole('ceo').

401.description: Missing Bearer token (requireRole returns 401 when req.user is unset).

403.description: Authenticated but not the CEO role.

post.description: Creates a new user account. Restricted to the CEO role via requireRole('ceo'). Rate limited to 30 mutations/min per IP. Username must be unique.

401.description: Missing Bearer token (requireRole returns 401 when req.user is unset).

403.description: Authenticated but not the CEO role.

get.description: Returns aggregate session and user statistics including active session counts and per-role breakdowns. Restricted to CEO and CTO roles via requireRole('ceo','cto').

401.description: Missing Bearer token (requireRole returns 401 when req.user is unset).

403.description: Authenticated but not a CEO or CTO.

get.summary: Get the dashboard for the currently authenticated user (role-resolved)
get.description: Returns the dashboard appropriate to the caller's role, derived from the session token. The shape of the returned `dashboard` varies by role (CEO/CTO/Developer/Artist/TechArtist). Requires any valid session.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Bearer session token: `Bearer <sessionId>` where sessionId is returned by POST /api/auth/login.

200.description: Role-specific dashboard payload. `dashboard` is one of the per-role schemas; `role` echoes the caller's role.

401.description: No token provided, token invalid/expired, or req.user not populated.

500.description: Unexpected error while building the dashboard.
